ns2:course.label: Found of the US Air Force I
ns2:course.description: "The Foundations of the United States Air Force" is a survey course designed to introduce students to the United States Air Force and provides an overview of the basic characteristics, missions, and organization of the Air Force. Prerequisite: Requires concurrent enrollment with AFAS 102.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Requires concurrent enrollment with AFAS 102.
